# DevRites

> DevRites gives Claude Code, Codex, omp, pi, and Devin CLI the same repository-local engineering workflow. Focused skills handle engineering judgment, while a Go control plane manages workflow state and deterministic checks. DevRites is free and open source under the MIT license.

DevRites ships 33 public workflow skills, focused internal skills, and 17 fresh-context role profiles through generated project-local surfaces. A CGO-free, stdlib-only `devrites-engine` binary manages workspace state, gates, derived data, migration, installation, updates, and uninstall. Feature state lives as git-diffable Markdown under `.devrites/work/<slug>/`, so another agent or host can resume from recorded project state.

## Lifecycle

The normal feature path is:

- spec (`/rite-spec` or `$rite-spec`): investigate the codebase and living capability ledger; write the product contract and measurable acceptance criteria
- clarify (`/rite-clarify` or `$rite-clarify`): close material ambiguity and record decision coverage
- temper (`/rite-temper` or `$rite-temper`): optional strategic review and pre-mortem; mandatory in autocomplete
- define (`/rite-define` or `$rite-define`): write architecture, plan, traceable vertical slices, and the acceptance-to-proof matrix
- vet (`/rite-vet` or `$rite-vet`): mandatory stakes-scaled engineering review before code
- build (`/rite-build` or `$rite-build`): implement exactly one verified slice test-first, then stop with evidence
- converge (`/rite-converge` or `$rite-converge`): compare live code with the recorded contract and add traceable remaining work
- prove (`/rite-prove` or `$rite-prove`): tests, build, runtime, and browser proof against every acceptance criterion
- polish (`/rite-polish` or `$rite-polish`): behavior-preserving code cleanup and UI polish when relevant
- review (`/rite-review` or `$rite-review`): independent spec and standards axes over the feature diff
- seal (`/rite-seal` or `$rite-seal`): GO / NO-GO decision; no git mutation
- ship (`/rite-ship` or `$rite-ship`): literal type-GO, approved git ladder, capability-ledger sync, and workspace archive

`rite-plan repair` fixes recorded drift. `rite-upgrade` audits an older active workspace against current contracts and routes only cited defects to the owning phase.

## Control plane

`devrites-engine help` lists every command and hook. Common commands:

- `devrites-engine check readiness <slug>`: validate required files, the task graph, and Build-input binding
- `devrites-engine check seal <slug>`: recheck final files, gates, binding, and candidate evidence
- `devrites-engine check candidate <slug>`: validate and hash the closed project candidate
- `devrites-engine gates status <slug>`: read the machine-checked acceptance ledger
- `devrites-engine orient <slug>`: sanitized JSON workspace summary
- `devrites-engine next [slug]`: minimal remaining lifecycle path
- `devrites-engine state resolve <qid> "<answer>"`: resolve a human gate atomically
- `devrites-engine secret-scan [--staged] [slug]`: block on HIGH-confidence secret findings

Exit 3 is a structured human-in-the-loop pause, not a crash. Workspace state and gate commands make no model or network calls. Explicit install, update, and source-cache I/O is isolated behind named engine boundaries.

## Hosts and safety

- Claude Code uses `/rite <verb>` or `/rite-<verb>`; Codex uses `$rite <verb>` or `$rite-<verb>`.
- omp, pi, and Devin CLI use their generated native workflow surfaces.
- CI, local scripts, and humans call `devrites-engine` directly.
- Skills, agents, standards, guidance, and hooks stay in the target project rather than global agent directories.
- The optional shared `devrites-engine` executable may be installed in a user or system bin directory; pass `--no-binary` to skip it.
- Spec Drift Guard records a plan mismatch and routes it through repair before the build resumes.
- AFK mode runs unattended but pauses on destructive migrations, auth/authz changes, public-API breaks, red checks, and hard gates.
- Type-GO protects irreversible git operations.

## Install

- Install: `npx devrites@latest`
- Update: `npx devrites@latest update`
- Uninstall: `npx devrites@latest uninstall`
- Without Node: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ViktorsBaikers/DevRites/main/install.sh | bash`
- Preview any install path with `--dry-run`; skip the shared binary with `--no-binary`.
